source.title: Volatility Models: the ARCH framework
source.author: Stephen Taylor
source.page_numbering: One-based PDF page numbers, including cover.

source_scope: Original Thai exposition with newly constructed worked examples; no source slide reproduction or reconstructed historical observations.

conventions.returns: Daily log returns in decimal units; mean zero in all numerical examples.
conventions.variance: Squared decimal returns per daily observation. Multiply by 10000 for percent-squared.
conventions.forecast_origin: End of day t; k=1 is h_(t+1), known after observing r_t.
conventions.aggregate_variance: Sum of conditional variance forecasts for cumulative log returns, with constant mean and martingale-difference residuals.
conventions.half_life: Decay of variance forecast gap from long-run variance; extra periods after the first forecast.

likelihood_example.data_status: Eight handcrafted hypothetical returns, no random sampling or market fit.
likelihood_example.method: Conditional Gaussian likelihood and a restricted educational parameter grid; not continuous MLE and no standard errors.
likelihood_example.seeds: Not applicable; examples and figures are deterministic.

clarifications_from_source: Radicals verified visually in source: ARCH-M uses conditional SD, not variance.
Finite unconditional variance condition distinguished from strict stationarity.
Half-life is for variance gap, not SD gap.
GJR gamma/2 requires symmetric unit-variance innovations.
Likelihood inference at a boundary requires model-specific theory; fail to reject is not acceptance.
Gaussian QMLE does not validate Normal tails.

visuals.design_system: QuantCorner / QuantSeras, existing light book layout with optional dark theme

external_references.title: Self and Liang (1987), boundary likelihood theory

limitations: No empirical estimation, out-of-sample backtest, standard errors or live risk advice.
publication_authorization: Owner explicitly requested insertion and GitHub publication after reviewing the local draft.
